<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum lists the chemical shifts: 139.25, 134.60, 129.00 (twice), 128.30 (twice), 49.40, 26.10, and 11.40. Each distinct shift corresponds to a unique carbon environment. Counting the distinct values gives 7 different carbon environments.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
